heroes.name: 曹操
heroes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone portrait artwork for a Three Kingdoms strategy mobile game's hero card and avatar. Create ONE character illustration only.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted East Asian fantasy card illustration, disciplined ink contour lines, rich layered brushwork, semi-realistic adult faces, flowing fabric, exquisitely worked bronze and steel, dramatic but readable lighting. Cohesive with dark, richly colored Chinese historical fantasy collectible card artwork.
Composition/framing: vertical 35:48 aspect ratio (target 1400x1920 if possible). Full bleed rectangular painted background, opaque. One heroic figure in a three-quarter thigh-up view fills 80% of canvas; face large, fully visible in upper central third, head and ornaments inside the top margin. Distinctive weapon clearly readable. Strong clean silhouette and recognizable face at a 350x480 thumbnail. Keep critical face and weapon details away from outer edges.
Constraints: ORIGINAL artwork. NO text, letters, calligraphy, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, card border, frame, star badges, UI, collage, panels, or other foreground characters. No photorealistic photograph, no 3D render, no chibi. Anatomically plausible hands and weapons. Make a finished game-ready illustration, not a concept sheet.
Subject: Cao Cao (曹操), five-star Warrior, signature skill "Hero of a Turbulent Age / 乱世奸雄". A powerful, calculating middle-aged Chinese warlord, narrow perceptive eyes, neatly groomed black mustache and pointed short beard. Black and deep indigo Han-inspired lamellar armor with restrained antique-gold dragon motifs, dark red cloak caught by wind, traditional crown/topknot. One hand rests naturally on a sheathed straight command sword at his waist. Upright confident commander's posture, slightly three-quarter face toward viewer, strategic authority rather than berserk rage. Background: distant cavalry banners and fortress silhouettes beneath cold storm clouds; subtle warm gold rim light. Palette: midnight blue, blackened bronze, garnet and muted gold.

Subject: Zhang Fei (张飞), four-star Tank, signature skill "Dangyang Bridge / 当阳桥"; highest defense and low speed. A massive broad-shouldered muscular adult Chinese warrior with fierce round eyes, thick wild black beard, dark tied-up hair. Heavy blackened iron lamellar armor, battered bronze fittings, rugged dark-red scarf. Braced in a very stable wide defensive stance across an old bridge; shoulders and armored torso look weighty and indomitable. Holds a single long serpent-headed spear diagonally, distinctive curved serpentine spear tip clearly visible. Mouth open in a controlled battle roar, heroic not monstrous. Background: old wooden bridge receding into cold river mist and dust, no extra foreground people. Palette: charcoal iron, weathered bronze, dark oxblood and cold mist blue.
heroes.correctionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Zhang Fei hero-card illustration. Change ONLY the metal weapon head at the upper right: replace the broad crescent axe-like blade with Zhang Fei's iconic serpent spear (丈八蛇矛), a LONG NARROW spear point, approximately 1.5 head-heights in length and no more than one-third of the character's head width, shaped as a gently sinuous double-edged steel spear point continuing ALONG THE AXIS of the existing straight shaft. The tip must be a piercing point at the far end, with dark forged steel and restrained bronze details at the socket. NO broad side blade, no crescent blade, no hook, no axe, no dragon-face ornament on the spear blade. Preserve the original character identity, face, wild beard, roar, pose, both hands gripping the same shaft, heavy armor, scarf, bridge, background, all lighting and colors, painting style, original portrait aspect ratio and framing. Full bleed opaque background, no text, no UI, no borders. Everything except the weapon head must remain unchanged.
